title: Documentation ownership
summary: Public product guidance is authored under docs/public and derived into installed .yoke/docs and the packaged corpus; web delivery consumes the exact candidate. The shared allowed-path pattern and identity file names are published in packages/yoke-core/src/yoke_core/ui/contracts/docs-corpus-files.json. Project policy, live facts and private operations retain their own owners. docs/teaching is source-contributor material and never installs. Global hook orientation, user-level yoke-global appearance and actual global receiving proof remain owned by YOK-3975; their absence is not delivery success. The contracts docs_corpus_files module owns the public file allowlist: Markdown, nav.yaml, CSS/SVG/HTML assets and root identity files. Shared corpus validation refuses unsupported files and symlinks before reading them, with DOCS_CORPUS_UNEXPECTED_FILE and removal guidance.
